support:tags:div_ceil.note: Compiler fixture: divceil.zig's AIR exported by the patched 0.17.0 compiler (ReleaseSafe, x86_64-linux), with Sema's minInt/-1 and divide-by-zero checks before div_ceil. Differential: the translation run on 1652 inputs (edge pairs and seeded random, i8/u8/i13/i32/u32/i64/u64) equals stock Zig 0.17.0 on aarch64-macos, aarch64-linux and x86_64-linux: 1562 values, and 90 inputs where both panic with the same check (division by zero / integer overflow). Rejections: div_ceil on a 0.16.0 file and div_ceil_optimized (tests/roadmap/zig017/reject). Contract: Zig.divCeil (ZigLean/Basic.lean). CI reruns check.sh on the 0.17.0 row.
